partner.name: MSME
partner.task: Prepare an accurate customer response and a daily work checklist.
partner.learningTitle: Customer communication and daily operations with AI
partner.credentialClaim: Demonstrated customer-draft preparation, operations checklist creation and responsible AI checking using synthetic business records
credentialExclusions: No financial, tax or legal professional qualification
No assurance of business results or automated customer commitments
partner.learningSourceNotice: The example order policy and records are fictional fixtures, not a recommended business policy.

fields.name: partner
fields.constraint: Exactly the partner ID shown in this checklist: agri, msme or public.

fields.name: event_id
fields.constraint: Internal local event reference; 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Does not identify a receiving partner account.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.constraint: Canonical UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ, checked by a date round-trip.

fields.name: enrollment_ref
fields.constraint: Internal saved-learning reference; 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Not a partner account link.

fields.name: content_version
fields.constraint: 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore or hyphen. A local test must match the exact retained enrollment and choice version; no substitute version.

fields.name: scopes
fields.constraint: One or both of learning.progress and practice.record, each once. The builder uses that order. Optional summary objects must exactly match these scopes.

fields.name: learning.completed_lessons
fields.constraint: 0 through total_lessons; the command verifies distinct completed lesson IDs against the exact pinned curriculum.

fields.name: learning.total_lessons
fields.constraint: 1 through 100; taken from the exact pinned curriculum.

fields.name: learning.status
fields.constraint: completed if the two counts are equal; otherwise in-progress.

fields.name: practice_record.status
fields.constraint: not-issued, active or suspended. This is a local non-accredited practice status.

fields.name: practice_record.review_mode
fields.constraint: not-reviewed exactly when status is not-issued; otherwise sample-workflow. Does not establish a professional or institutional review.

localContract.shapeRule: The top-level envelope and selected summary objects reject unsupported fields. Optional summary objects are present exactly when selected. Local receipts are simulated, never partner acknowledgements.
localContract.historyRule: The server checks the current saved choice and pinned learning for every new local test. Existing valid receipts remain snapshots after expiry, withdrawal or a later practice-status change.

decisions.question: Which service receives the summary, and how is the right account confirmed?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Partner service specification and account-link/authentication design. Do not record account identifiers in this checklist.

decisions.question: What exact purpose and fields are permitted, and what happens if a learner declines?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Agreed purpose, minimum field list, retention period and an accessible explanation of declining. A local choice is not approval for a live return.

decisions.question: Which partner-owned specification and compatibility tests will both sides accept?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Version policy, acknowledgements, retries, duplicate-event handling, errors and status-correction tests. The current local contract establishes none of these for a partner.

decisions.question: Where does stopping take effect, and who handles a changed status or retained data?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Stop boundary, in-flight requests, correction process, retention/deletion responsibilities and evidence of a stop test. Local withdrawal only stops future local tests.

decisions.question: Which responsible roles can pause, resolve and resume an exchange?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Operating owner role, backup role, pause authority, escalation route and recovery exercise. Academy membership is not institutional authority.

decisions.question: Which override, failure and reporting protections are confirmed for the people doing the work?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Institution-confirmed written override permission, responsibility for failures and protection for reporting concerns. These items are open in the supplied teaching material.

decisions.question: What continues if the partner or programme leaves?
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Audit/remediation rights, export and continuity responsibilities, and a funded exit plan where relevant.

boundaryChecks.check: Add a name, score, note or any unsupported payload field.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject the return. No extra field is transmitted or accepted by this local contract.

boundaryChecks.check: Omit a selected summary, add an unselected summary, repeat a scope or use an unsupported scope.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject the return; selected fields and summary objects must agree.

boundaryChecks.check: Use another mapped pathway, private workspace pin or a different retained version.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject a new local test. Do not substitute the current curriculum for an unavailable pin.

boundaryChecks.check: Run a new test at the exact saved expiry time.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject the new test at now >= expiry. Earlier valid receipts remain historical local snapshots.

boundaryChecks.check: Withdraw a valid retained choice, then try a new test.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject the new test. Preserve earlier receipts; withdrawal is not a partner deletion promise.

boundaryChecks.check: Withdraw a valid retained choice while learning is paused or retained receipt history is malformed.
boundaryChecks.expected: Allow the independent withdrawal. Do not require a new test or readable receipt history to stop future local tests.

boundaryChecks.check: Present a receipt created in the future, before its retained choice, at/after expiry or after withdrawal.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject that receipt history. Current time and retained choice timing are checked; a valid old receipt is not current permission.

boundaryChecks.check: Reach 24 retained choices or 100 retained receipts.
boundaryChecks.expected: Reject a further choice or test respectively. Keep retained history and independent withdrawal available.
